# GigaRoute AI

> GigaRoute AI is manufacturing-logistics (AMHS) simulation software. GRS (GigaRoute Script) is the script language used for Model Logic in GR Simulation Studio.

## GRS reference (static pages, no JavaScript required)

- [Help index](https://gigaroute.ai/help/): entry point with links to every section
- [Language basics](https://gigaroute.ai/help/language.html): blocks, statements, expressions, loops, common compile errors (all samples compiler-checked)
- [Complete reference in Markdown](https://gigaroute.ai/help/syntax.md): every event, action, function and attribute in one file
- [Structured reference (JSON)](https://gigaroute.ai/help/reference.json): same content as data
